algebraic_domain: principal real embedding of exact cyclotomic sums generated by roots of unity

domain.ordering: n ascending, then itertools.combinations lexicographic order

interval_policy.acceptance: strictly positive lower endpoint for an integer Rayleigh vector
interval_policy.atan: alternating rational series with next-term enclosure
interval_policy.cos: outward Decimal Taylor enclosure through degree 140 plus Lagrange remainder
interval_policy.floating_role: candidate pivot/vector proposal only; never acceptance

malformed_input_behavior: any command-line argument -> stderr diagnostic and exit status 2
source_output_binding: summary contains source SHA-256; certificate SHA-256 hashes canonical JSONL bytes
